;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**Syrian government airstrikes targeting residential areas in the towns of Jisr al-Shughur, Khan Shaykhun, Maar Shoreen, Hantoteen and Ain Al Bardeh in [[Idlib province]], kill at least nine civilians and injure 14 others. ;Business and economy

[https://seekingalpha.com/news/3478264-amazon-refutes-congressional-antitrust-concern?dr=1#email_link (Seeking Alpha)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Odebrecht#Legal problems|Odebrecht case]]
**Former [[President of Peru]] [[Alejandro Toledo]] is arrested in the [[United States]] following an extradition request. [https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/california/articles/2019-07-16/peru-says-former-president-alejandro-toledo-arrested-in-us (''US News'')]
*American musician [[R. Kelly]] pleads not guilty to federal sex-assault charges but is denied bail. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/r-kelly-pleads-not-guilty-denied-bail-sweeping-sex-crime-n1030441 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Telegramgate scandal]]
**[[Governor of Puerto Rico|Puerto Rico Governor]] [[Ricardo Rosselló]] says that he will remain in office despite protests. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/puerto-rico-governor-ricardo-rossello-defies-calls-to-resign-despite-escalating-protests/ (CBS News)]
*The [[European Parliament]] elects [[Ursula von der Leyen]] of [[Germany]] as the new [[President of the European Commission]]. Succeeding [[Jean-Claude Juncker]], she will be sworn in on 1 November 2019. She is the first woman to be elected to this office in EU history. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49010801 (BBC News)]
*[[Christine Lagarde]] announces that she will step down as managing director of the [[International Monetary Fund]] on 12 September 2019. [https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/business-49009226 (BBC News)]
